title: Black Bars when renaming or moving files
body:
### Tested versions

Tested 4.5.2, 4.6.2, and 4.7.1 - all stable versions


### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.5.2) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (12 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When renaming or moving a file, such as the icon.svg, black bars appear on the screen which eventually cause the system to crash. 

If I switch to Compatibility for the renderer it fixes the issue.


I have recently (with the last 3 months) reinstalled my OS and no modifications have been made, still a stock experience. This  could also be a Tahoe bug, I'm not against reinstalling with Sonoma if needed, but I hope that will be a last resort.
